title: Performance Improvement Approval Form
subtitle: Use this approval to test evidence and authority, resolve conflicts, issue a bounded decision, and verify every resulting update for a performance improvement workflow.
description: An original operational performance improvement approval form that controls a objective performance-support and review record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the manager, employee, or HR case owner needs a traceable approval so the qualified HR, employee-relations, legal, or management reviewer can start, revise, extend, complete, close, or escalate the performance-improvement process under the current job description, consistently applied performance standards, accommodation process, employee-relations policy, and applicable employment requirements without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Performance Improvement approval submission and authority route
sections.guidance: Identify the proposed action, submitter, decision authority, effective point, and required evidence.

blocks.label: Performance Improvement identity
Approval ownership and routing
Approval control
Proposed action, purpose, exact scope, affected people or work, exclusions, and requested conditions

sections.title: Performance Improvement evidence completeness and readiness
sections.guidance: Reject unsupported assumptions before the decision reaches an approver.

blocks.label: Performance Improvement approval readiness
items: Concern is supported by objective, job-related evidence
Expectation and measure are clear and consistently applied
Employee response and contrary evidence received fair review
Resources, training, tools, and manager support are feasible
Accommodation and protected-activity indicators have independent routing
Review period and checkpoints allow meaningful feedback
Manager conflict and comparable-treatment checks are complete
Qualified HR reviewer approved the process, conditions, and communication

blocks.label: Evidence package submitted
items: Current job description, role duty, or conduct standard
Work product, service, deadline, quality, attendance, or outcome record
Prior direction, coaching, feedback, and employee response
Approved target, measure, baseline, and review schedule
Training, tools, access, workload, and manager-support evidence
Checkpoint notes and employee-provided evidence
Separate HR routing reference for confidential or protected concerns
Qualified review, decision communication, follow-up, or closure record

blocks.label: Required item, evidence, owner, status, and deficiency

sections.title: Performance Improvement policy, authority, and impact review
sections.guidance: Apply the current decision standard and record each reviewer within their actual authority.

blocks.label: Performance Improvement policy and impact checks
items: Expectation is tied to an essential output, conduct rule, or documented role duty
Standard is specific, measurable where feasible, attainable, relevant, and time-bounded
Evidence identifies dates, work products, expected result, and observed gap
Comparable employees and prior applications support consistent treatment
Employee explanation and contrary evidence are captured without prejudgment
Training, tools, access, workload, direction, and manager support were assessed
Accommodation or protected-activity indicators are routed to qualified HR
Checkpoint ratings use the stated measure and review period
Consequences are not predetermined before the evidence period closes
Final conclusion distinguishes sustained improvement, partial progress, and unresolved gap

blocks.label: Review area, reviewer, authority, evidence, finding, and condition
People, schedule, service, cost, payroll, privacy, security, safety, consistency, and system impacts

sections.title: Performance Improvement conflicts, exceptions, and approval conditions
sections.guidance: Resolve material conflicts and convert every condition into owned, verifiable work.

blocks.label: Approval stop and escalation boundary
blocks.guidance: Pause any action outside documented authority. Protect privacy, preserve the original evidence, and route urgent, safety, security, retaliation, or legal concerns to the qualified HR, employee-relations, legal, or management reviewer under the current job description, consistently applied performance standards, accommodation process, employee-relations policy, and applicable employment requirements.

blocks.label: Performance Improvement exception and escalation triggers
items: Record contains medical details or confidential accommodation information
Employee reports retaliation, discrimination, harassment, coercion, or interference
Expectation or measure changed without notice during the review period
Required coaching, tools, access, workload decision, or feedback was not provided
Manager evidence is inaccurate, altered, incomplete, or attributed to the wrong employee
Comparable-employee or prior-treatment information indicates inconsistent application
Decision was communicated or implemented before required HR review
Threat, violence, self-harm, safety, or emergency concern requires immediate qualified routing

blocks.label: Exception, immediate action, owner, due point, and disposition register
Exception facts, affected scope, privacy boundary, unresolved risk, and escalation rationale
Approval condition, prerequisite, owner, due point, evidence, and expiry

sections.title: Performance Improvement approval decision and effective boundary
sections.guidance: Record one unambiguous decision with rationale, authority, conditions, and review date.

blocks.label: Approval boundary
blocks.guidance: Approval is valid only within the stated scope and authority. The qualified HR, employee-relations, legal, or management reviewer must apply the current job description, consistently applied performance standards, accommodation process, employee-relations policy, and applicable employment requirements; a signature does not override a required privacy, safety, security, legal, payroll, tax, or accommodation review.

blocks.label: Approval decision
Evidence relied upon, contrary evidence, alternatives, conditions, limits, and reason for decision
Submission, qualified review, and decision authorization

fields.label: Qualified Hr, Employee-Relations, Legal, Or Management Reviewer / date

sections.title: Performance Improvement implementation, notification, and approval closeout
sections.guidance: Verify that the approved outcome reached every affected system and recipient.

blocks.label: Approved implementation, system update, notification, and verification
Approval outcome and handoff
Open performance improvement action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance
Approval accountable review

fields.label: Qualified Hr, Employee-Relations, Legal, Or Management Reviewer / date
